How Agencies Host 20+ Client Apps on One Managed Server

One well-sized managed server can hold twenty-plus light-to-moderate client apps, as long as each app is truly isolated (its own system user, database, and SSL) and you can back up and deploy them one at a time. What stays flat as you scale: your logins, your dashboard, your bill. What grows: apps, databases, and domains, which is fine because they're a few clicks each.

How Agencies Host 20+ Client Apps on One Managed Server

Quick thread 🧵

One well-sized managed server can hold twenty-plus light-to-moderate client apps, as long as each app is truly isolated (its own system user, database, and SSL) and you can back up and deploy them one at a time.
What stays flat as you scale: your logins, your dashboard, your bill.
What grows: apps, databases, and domains, which is fine because they're a few clicks each.
Move the heaviest client to its own server when it earns it.
